rules.build:
case "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" in powerpc64*) LIBUCONTEXT_ARCH="ppc64" ;; *) LIBUCONTEXT_ARCH="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE%%-*}" ;; esac
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make -j"$AELTRA_PARALLEL_JOBS" \ ARCH="$LIBUCONTEXT_ARCH" \ CC="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-gcc" \ AR="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-ar" \ CFLAGS="$CFLAGS" \ LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS" \ prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX"
rules.install:
case "$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" in powerpc64*) LIBUCONTEXT_ARCH="ppc64" ;; *) LIBUCONTEXT_ARCH="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE%%-*}" ;; esac
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make \ ARCH="$LIBUCONTEXT_ARCH" \ CC="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-gcc" \ AR="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE-ar" \ CFLAGS="$CFLAGS" \ LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS" \ prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" \ install
